notes: Omen experiences (CEO 2026-09-30, "a layout is an experience"): five whole-screen compositions chosen from Omen's right-click menu, Experience, each drawn from the live readings and answering the screen's shape (monitor, square, tower…

Each experience changes with what the machine is doing: in a game the frame rate takes the lead, and when a CPU or GPU reaches 90°C the experience names the hot part. A reading the machine does not report is not drawn.

Omen's status badge is hidden while an experience is on. New panel setting experience (none by default: Omen's own cards are unchanged). Moving parts (Ember's embers) run at 15 frames a second and stop while the portal is covered.
Scope draws CPU load per second over the last minute: the sensor feed does not yet carry each core's load.
